chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar from Safwan from 'Isa ibn al-Qasim said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the cheetahs and birds of prey, is trade sought in them? He said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.سِبَاعِ الطَّيْرِ: Birds of prey (lions of the sky)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy and sell cheetahs and birds of prey in Islamic law?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on earnings, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the commercial validity of wild animals like cheetahs and birds of prey as tradable assets (*mal*). This ruling reflects the practical economic realities of the early Shia community, where hunting with trained animals was a significant source of livelihood and status, thereby legitimizing their acquisition and sale in the marketplace.
